name: (I see) Nothing
source:
You woke up in a hospital after a surgery to restore your eye-sight. The hospital stay is long and boring, but fortunately your good friend from school and a charismatic male nurse are keeping you company. But is everything really as idyllic as it seems? Was the surgery completely successful? And why does it seem like someone is keeping a dark secret? Will you find out what it is or do you really see NOTHING?

[from [url=https://painappuruproject.itch.io/i-see-nothingnasshingu]itch.io[/url]]
